title: Hymn of the Seven Huts (Ka Jingrwai U Hynniewtrep)
cultural_context: National patriotic song sung at community gatherings, Seng Kut Snem, and Khasi cultural assemblies celebrating the divine descent of the Seven Huts from Mount Sohpetbneng.
lyrics_khasi:
Na Lum Sohpetbneng ngi la hiar ban im,
Ki Hynñiew Trep ba kyntang ha pyrthei,
Ban kamai ïa ka hok, ban burom ïa U Blei,
Pynneh ïa ka akor, pynskhem ïa ka niam!

Ka Ri jong ngi ka ri jong ka hok,
Ym don ba lah ban pynduh ia ka burom;
Pateng la pateng ngin pynriewspah ia ka,
Da ka bor jong ka kti bad ka mynsiem ba khuid!
lyrics_english:
Down from Mount Sohpetbneng we descended into earthly life,
The Seven Sacred Huts consecrated upon the green earth,
To earn righteousness through labor, to revere Almighty God,
Preserving our ancestral courtesy, anchoring our ancient faith!

Our beloved motherland is the land of truth and righteousness,
None has power to destroy her sacred glory;
Generation after generation we shall enrich her,
With the work of our hands and the purity of our souls!

stanzas.title: Ka Jinghiar na Lum Sohpetbneng (Descent from Sohpetbneng)
stanzas.khasi:
Na Lum Sohpetbneng ngi la hiar ban im,
Ki Hynñiew Trep ba kyntang ha pyrthei,

stanzas.english: From Mount Sohpetbneng we came down to dwell, the sacred Seven Huts upon earth, to earn righteousness, revere God, and anchor our faith!

vocabulary.hynniewtrep: The Seven Huts who settled the earth, ancestors of the Khasi-Pnar people
vocabulary.sohpetbneng: Navel of Heaven; sacred peak in Ri Bhoi
vocabulary.kamai ia ka hok: The foundational Khasi precept: to earn righteousness through honest labor
